title: Opt-in local reranking with Qwen3-Reranker through Ollama
description: Opt-in (off by default) reranking of the top 12 fused passages with fanyx/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B-Q8_0 through the single Ollama runtime: raw /api/generate with logprobs, scored as P(yes)/(P(yes)+P(no)). Settings shows a toggle that says it adds about 10 s per answer; it is disabled until the reranker model is installed and verified. Any reranker failure falls back to fusion order and is recorded in the trace.
acceptance_criteria: Given the reranker is installed and enabled, when a question is answered, then the top 12 fused passages are reordered by reranker score and the answer trace says it was reranked.
Given the reranker is disabled, missing or failing, when a question is answered, then fusion order is used, the answer completes, and the trace records why reranking was skipped.
Given the reranker model is installed, when it is verified, then its pinned digest, completion capability and a relevant-above-irrelevant logprob probe must pass before it can be enabled.
Given Settings, when the reranker is not installed, then the toggle is disabled with a plain reason and a link to download it.
test_cases: Probe-pair ordering test against fixtures; skip/fallback path; latency evidence from Phase 0 and live verification.
verification: Phase 0 S1 (2026-10-09): the method works on ara-ollama 0.40.1-ara.2. dengcao 0.6B Q8_0 is broken (uniform logits). dengcao 0.6B F16 took 54 s for 30 candidates. At the user's request the lead tested fanyx/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B-Q8_0 (digest fd021d86a15e539ac1b4f3bec2d1c6b15a3e158f316adb0d1325c713240103b3, 639,152,466 bytes): 12/12 probe pairs, relevant median 0.997, irrelevant median 0.094. 30 candidates took 21.99 s (p50 0.72 s per call) against 51.37 s for F16 in the same session, so about 9 s for 12. The user chose opt-in, off by default (2026-10-09). Not yet implemented.
